scope: Visual refinement of the selected UI system; no runtime code changes in this review.

existing_runtime.focus: Elapsed timer starting at 00:00; records observations silently; ending shows duration and new observation count.
existing_runtime.audio_limits: Four live sliders exist. Slider settings are session-level; sound enabled choices persist. Existing sound presets also switch weather.
existing_runtime.observation: Normal discovery records automatically; replay and viewing a guide page do not grant collection or visits.
existing_runtime.history: Recent and offline observation records exist.

proposed_features_not_implemented: Three seed varieties with consumable inventory quantities
Food capacity / remaining percentage and quantity stepper
Manual record transaction required before automatic discovery is saved

refinement_notes.recommendation: Keep the five-tool dock and small visitor strip. Feeding popover is closed at rest and anchored to its selected tool when opened; one active popover at a time.
Use 观察 / 投喂 / 图鉴 / 奇遇 / 陪伴 consistently. Distinguish 已收录 or 查看档案 from a manual 记录 action, because discovery is already saved automatically.
One headline total 图鉴 12/50. Within the selected species show 来访 3 次 and 渐渐熟悉, then a five-slot keepsake milestone. Remove the unexplained 记录进度 2/4 meter from the selected reference.

Discovered tiles show a name and star toggle; undiscovered tiles show muted silhouettes, question mark and a clue, with favorite/replay disabled. Do not show a rare-event illustration before discovery.

Use crisp 24/32-pixel icons and integer-scaled stepped borders; keep body Chinese readable, with pixel styling primarily in numerals, icons and outlines. At a 1440-wide composition target labels around 16–18px and generous line spacing.

Selected is pale olive fill plus a small pointer/check mark. Hover gets a brighter edge; pressed shifts inset by one or two pixels. Disabled remains legible with softened ink and no strong highlight. Do not rely on color alone.
Use a consistent specimen example: 麻雀 / 来访 3 次 / 渐渐熟悉 / 3 of 5 filled slots / 再来 2 次，留下纪念 / 一根小羽毛. Separate unique species count from repeat visits.

Quiet mode keeps a small timer and 暂存 2 discovery queue; full collection remains available after the session. Use the four implemented audio labels, and indicate timer presets as proposed UI behavior rather than already available.
